facts.business: Banka BioLoo Limited is a technology-driven social enterprise delivering integrated sanitation and water solutions across design, engineering, execution, and lifecycle management, transforming wastewater into a sustainable water resource.
facts.related_party_note: Proposed transactions with subsidiary Enzotech Solutions Private Limited for FY 2026-27 include sale/purchase of goods (Rs 2,500 Lakhs), availing/rendering services (Rs 2,000 Lakhs), property transactions (Rs 500 Lakhs), leasing (Rs 100 Lakhs), capital contribution (Rs 1,000 Lakhs), loans/ICDs/advances (Rs 1,000 Lakhs), security for loans (Rs 1,000 Lakhs), and guarantees (Rs 4,000 Lakhs), totalling Rs 12,100 Lakhs. Company holds 72.80% in subsidiary as of March 31, 2026 and 69.53% as of report date. Subsidiary standalone turnover Rs 585.63 Lakhs, PAT Rs 14.80 Lakhs, net worth Rs 1,110.64 Lakhs for FY 2025-26.
